children: Yields on U.K. 30-year government bonds, or gilts, rise modestly as investors await a potential long-dated gilt syndication this week. The Debt Management Office announced plans to sell January 2056 gilt via syndication in the week starting September 7, subject to demand and market conditions. The DMO also plans to sell 5 billion pounds in a new May 2030 gilt through an auction on Thursday. Thirty-year gilt yields climb 0.4 basis point to last trade at 5.785%, Tradeweb data show. (miriam.mukuru@wsj.com)
